idea-plugin.name: Flexppuccin
idea-plugin.description:
Flexppuccin: Warm Catppuccin Latte with Flexoki Paper Tones

An unofficial warm variant of the Catppuccin Latte theme. The cool blue-slate backgrounds are replaced with the paper and ink tones of Flexoki Light by Steph Ango, while keeping Catppuccin's pastel syntax highlighting.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Catppuccin organization. Based on the MIT-licensed catppuccin/jetbrains theme.

Features

  • Warm Paper Backgrounds: Flexoki paper and neutral tones (#fffcf0, #f2f0e5, #e6e4d9) instead of cool blue-tinted grays.
  • Deep Ink Typography: Near-black ink text (#100f0f) with strong contrast against the paper backgrounds.
  • Catppuccin Accents: Pastel syntax highlights (Mauve, Peach, Teal, Green, Lavender, Yellow).
  • Islands UI & Standard UI Support: Includes both standard and Islands theme variants.
  • Italics & Non-Italics Options: Bundles both italicized and non-italicized editor color schemes.

Usage

User Interface

  • Head to Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance
  • Select Flexppuccin

Editor Color Scheme

  • Head to Settings → Editor → Color Scheme
  • Select Flexppuccin or Flexppuccin (no italics)
